purpose: Treat one utterance/line as one semantic object with unequal projections for communication, decorum, language study and rehearsal.
laws: SEMANTIC INTENT IS NOT THE SAME AS WORDING
REGISTER CHANGE MUST NOT SILENTLY CHANGE COMMITMENT
REHEARSAL PROJECTIONS ARE NOT SEND ACTIONS
CULTURE-SPECIFIC DECORUM REQUIRES AN EXPLICIT PACK OR HUMAN REVIEW
TEMPORAL-FOCUS/RSVP IS A PROJECTION, NOT A NEW SOURCE

sendable.role: Current message wording for actual human use.

elegant.role: Compressed/refined expression preserving intent and decorum.

rehearsal.role: Chunked cueing, pauses, stress, turn-taking or memorization units.

rsvp.role: Temporal-focus sequence derived from the line; never canonical source.

backtranslation.role: Meaning-check projection to detect drift after translation/register transform.

round_trip_rule: A transformed line is acceptable only if backtranslation/readback preserves the consequential meaning of the canonical intent within declared uncertainty.
